hypothesis: Directionally large two-bar price impact persists after quote-volume shocks when elevated trade counts indicate broad participation and both quote volume and participation remain above their causal baselines for the next three completed bars.
falsifier: The thesis is falsified if the exact sign inversion is not worse, persistence-conditioned events do not improve on the shock-only ablation, or net performance is unstable across fixed folds and nearby causal horizons after stated costs.
formation_horizon: A 14-day 42-bar causal liquidity baseline plus two event bars, three post-event confirmation bars, and an 18-bar event scan; volatility normalization uses up to 60 completed 8h returns.
rebalance_horizon: Every nine completed 8h bars (72 hours), anchored deterministically to Monday 1970-01-05 00:00 UTC; non-rebalance decisions retain quantities.
control_profile: Dollar-neutral matched long/short event selection, three symbols maximum per side, 15% absolute weight per symbol, cash when fewer than two symbols qualify per side, per-bar volatility normalization for ranking, and symbol-ascending deterministic tie-breaks.
